definitions.gloss: natural material; natural fiber; organic material
definitions.explanation: Materials derived from nature rather than synthesized chemically. Includes plant fibers like cotton and linen, animal fibers like wool and silk, and other naturally occurring substances.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天然素材|てんねんそざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This garment is made from natural materials.

examples.japanese: {天然素材|てんねんそざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{優|やさ}しい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Natural materials are said to be gentle on the skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配慮|はいりょ}→配慮：07700_hairyo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{天然素材|てんねんそざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Out of concern for the environment, products made from natural materials rather than synthetics are gaining attention.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧ (natural, occurring in nature) and ⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ (material, raw material). Commonly used in fashion, interior design, and food contexts to distinguish products made from natural sources.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天然素材|てんねんそざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use natural materials
- {天然素材|てんねんそざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to insist on natural materials
- {天然素材|てんねんそざい}100%: 100% natural material
- {天然素材|てんねんそざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風合|ふうあ}い: the texture of natural materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {合成素材|ごうせいそざい}: synthetic material — artificially manufactured materials like polyester or nylon
- {有機素材|ゆうきそざい}: organic material — material produced through organic methods, often used in food contexts
- ⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: material — the base word, referring to any raw material or ingredient
